notes.zh: 邮件小秘书主程序和卸载程序启动时默认最大化，保留标准标题栏、任务栏和还原按钮。包含此前的更新连接备用入口修复。
notes.en: The main app and uninstaller now start maximized with standard window controls. Includes the previous update connection fallback fix.

notes.zh: 新增每5小时自动检查更新和手动检查；卸载选项使用固定保留标签，删除报告前再次确认；内附微软OAuth2辅助工具。
notes.en: Adds automatic update checks every five hours and manual checks. Uninstall switches use fixed retention labels, with confirmation before deleting reports. Includes the Microsoft OAuth2 helper.
